definitions.explanation: A level or rank within a social hierarchy. Used to discuss social stratification, economic classes, and demographic groups.
A level within a structured system, such as floors of a building, layers in computing, or tiers of an organization.

notes:
USAGE:
{階層|かいそう} is used across many domains: sociology (⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{階層|かいそう}), computing ({階層|かいそう}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧), architecture, and organizational theory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{階層|かいそう} (social class/stratum)
- ⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧{階層|かいそう} (income class)
- {階層|かいそう}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧ (hierarchical structure)
- ⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧/⟦{下位|かい}→下位：11710_kai⟧{階層|かいそう} (upper/lower tier)

WATCH OUT:
Several words share the reading かいそう but have different meanings:
- ⟦{回想|かいそう}→回想：11839_kaisou⟧: reminiscence
- ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧: renovation
- ⟦{海藻|かいそう}→海藻：06750_kaisou⟧: seaweed
